trigger_cases.prompt: Conduct a heuristic usability evaluation of our checkout form based on Nielsen Norman principles.
Audit our web application for cognitive load, error prevention, and clear affordances.
Review layout visual hierarchy and F-pattern scannability for our enterprise dashboard.
Deploy a PostgreSQL replica to Google Cloud Platform.
Configure an OAuth 2.1 PKCE token exchange.

binary_cases.prompt: Audit a complex multi-step settings form for usability and error prevention.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Applies Nielsen heuristics: inline validation, destructive action safeguards, top-aligned labels, and clear visual hierarchy.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Apply Nielsen Heuristic #5 (Error Prevention) with inline validation, top-aligned labels, clear visual hierarchy to reduce cognitive load, and non-destructive recovery paths.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Display a generic red outline with no error message and wipe all form fields on submit error.
